title: Potential IndexError
detail: If `ignored_nodes` is empty, accessing `ignored_nodes[-1]` will raise an `IndexError`. This could happen if the `# fmt: off` block is at the very end of the file and there are no other nodes to be ignored.

title: Potential race condition on lock acquisition
detail: If multiple spiders are exporting items concurrently, the `_export_lock.acquire()` call can be missed, leading to a race condition where multiple spiders attempt to acquire the lock simultaneously. This could lead to unexpected behavior or errors.
